<thought>Analyzing the isotopic envelope, the dominant pattern is a monoisotopic peak at m/z 100 with a clear M+1 peak at ~5.6 % intensity, consistent with the natural 13C abundance (~1.1 % per carbon) for a molecule containing several carbons. No characteristic Cl (35/37 ≈ 3:1) or Br (≈1:1) patterns are observed, and the M+2 intensity is far lower than expected for sulfur. Thus, carbon is the only element whose isotopic distribution can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
